sources.excerpt: Vintage Distortion by TC Electronic | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE TC Electronic Vintage Distortion LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION BOOSTER Description Often versatility is called upon and the Vintage Distortion pedal gives you all the choices you need, with a vintage twist. Go from jazzy laid-back sounds to mega fuzz sledge hammer action that will blow your toupee off. With the boost function bypassed you'll get a sound that makes you think of late night jazz sessions. Turn on the boost and your guitar is on the fast track to roaring thunders similar to legend rock albums of the past. Adjust the Tone knob for that extra edge to your sound it won't have an effect on your original sonic quality, so don't be a cheapskate, crank it up!
